economic_hypothesis: An exact SEC Form NT 10-K or NT 10-Q acceptance is a public signal that the registrant cannot file its periodic report on time. A short-stock, long-SPY pair entered after public acceptance may capture delayed incorporation of adverse reporting-quality and operating information.

event_definition.acceptance_clock: SEC submissions acceptanceDateTime parsed as exact UTC
event_definition.entry: first regular XNYS open strictly after acceptance_at plus decision lag
event_definition.exit: regular XNYS open 20 sessions after entry
event_definition.position: 50 percent short issuer and 50 percent long SPY per unit gross exposure
event_definition.same_ticker_overlap_policy: keep earliest accepted event and suppress later events until the prior 20-session holding interval exits
event_definition.same_entry_date_weighting: equal capital across all eligible events entering on that date
event_definition.cost_model: first-order traded-notional overlay on both pair legs, including entry and exit drift
event_definition.liquidity_measure: median dollar_volume over the 20 benchmark sessions ending one session before entry
event_definition.borrow_cost: omitted and therefore a deployment blocker

formal_tests.primary: confirmation combined-form equal-entry-date mean pair net return at 30 bps one-way
formal_tests.stress: confirmation combined-form equal-entry-date mean pair net return at 50 bps one-way
formal_tests.falsification: confirmation signed pre-event 20-session pair return and post-minus-pre mean
formal_tests.inference: Newey-West on entry-date portfolio returns with lag 3; centered circular moving-block bootstrap as sensitivity
formal_tests.multiplicity: Bonferroni screen using at least the disclosed global trial floor

hard_claim_limits: The historical universe is selected from 2026 survivors and lacks delisting returns and permanent security identifiers.
SEC API acceptance timestamps have not yet been reconciled to raw accession SGML headers.
Yahoo adjusted opens are not execution-grade quotes and may be retrospectively revised.
Historical stock-loan fees, locate availability, recall, financing and TAQ impact are absent.
The 2025 cohort must remain signal-only until a separately frozen reveal decision.
